premise: All autumn day Squirrel hides her best hazelnut behind her back whenever curious Acorn asks; at dusk she brings it out for Bear cub before his long winter sleep and buries it for him, safe till he wakes up hungry in spring.
inspiration: The Little Red Hen (folk), turned inside out: the one who seems to keep everything for herself is saving it for a friend.
lesson: Sometimes a secret is really a gift waiting for its moment.

en-US.title: Squirrel Hides a Present
en-US.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} It was autumn, and leaves came twirling down. {squirrel:enter} Squirrel had a secret: her very best hazelnut. Along came {acorn:enter} {acorn:go to squirrel} Acorn, curious as ever. {squirrel:face surprised} {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} Squirrel hid the nut behind her back, innocent as anything. [curious] {acorn:pulse} "What's behind your back?" asked Acorn. [mischievously] "Nothing!" said Squirrel. {acorn:live wish} So Acorn made a wish: "I wish I knew!" All day long it went like that. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop} "What's behind your back?" "Nothing!" [giggles] {canvas:sunset 0.7} Then, as the sun went down, {bear:enter} Bear cub came toddling by. [yawns] {bear:live talk} "Winter's coming," he said. "Time for my long sleep." {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Out came the hazelnut, with a hug. Then Squirrel {squirrel:go to bear} bounded over to Bear cub. [warmly] "This is for you. I'll {squirrel:live bury} bury it right here, safe, for when you wake up hungry in the spring." {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} Bear cub smiled, {bear:live nap hold} gave a great big yawn and nodded off. {sfx:snore} {acorn:face surprised} [whispers] "So THAT was the secret!" said Acorn. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hearts} "Not a secret any more," said Squirrel. "A promise."

es-ES.title: El secreto de Ardilla
es-ES.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Era otoño, y las hojas caían dando vueltas. {squirrel:enter} Ardilla tenía un secreto: su mejor avellana. Y llegó {acorn:enter} {acorn:go to squirrel} Bellota, curiosa como siempre. {squirrel:face surprised} {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} Ardilla escondió la avellana detrás de la espalda, con cara de no saber nada. [curious] {acorn:pulse} —¿Qué tienes ahí detrás? —preguntó Bellota. [mischievously] —¡Nada! —dijo Ardilla. {acorn:live wish} Así que Bellota pidió un deseo: —¡Ojalá lo supiera! Y así se pasaron el día entero. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop} —¿Qué tienes ahí detrás? —¡Nada! [giggles] {canvas:sunset 0.7} Entonces, cuando el sol se ponía, {bear:enter} Osito llegó despacito. [yawns] {bear:live talk} —Ya viene el invierno —dijo—. Me toca dormir mucho, mucho tiempo. {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Ardilla sacó la avellana y le dio un abrazo. Luego {squirrel:go to bear} fue dando brincos hasta Osito. [warmly] —Es para ti. Te la {squirrel:live bury} guardo aquí, bajo tierra, para cuando despiertes con hambre en primavera. {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} Osito sonrió, {bear:live nap hold} dio un bostezo enorme y se quedó dormido. {sfx:snore} {acorn:face surprised} [whispers] —¡Así que ese era el secreto! —dijo Bellota. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hearts} —Ya no es un secreto —dijo Ardilla—. Es una promesa.

ja-JP.title: リスさんの ひみつ
ja-JP.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}{sfx:leaves}あきです。はっぱが、くるくるまいおちてきます。{squirrel:enter}リスさんには、ひみつがありました。とっておきの木の実です。そこへ{acorn:enter}{acorn:go to squirrel}しりたがりやのどんぐりが、やってきました。{squirrel:face surprised}{squirrel:live hide-nut hold}リスさんは木の実をせなかにかくして、しらんぷり。[curious]{acorn:pulse}「せなかに、なにがあるの？」 とどんぐり。[mischievously]「なーんにも！」 とリスさん。{acorn:live wish}そこで、どんぐりはおねがい。「なにがあるか、わかりますように！」 いちにちじゅう、そのくりかえし。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop}「せなかに、なにがあるの？」 「なーんにも！」 [giggles]{canvas:sunset 0.7}お日さまがしずむころ、{bear:enter}こぐまが、よちよちやってきました。[yawns]{bear:live talk}「もうすぐふゆだね。ながーくねむるじかんだ」 {squirrel:live hide-nut resume}リスさんは木の実をとりだして、ぎゅっ。それから{squirrel:go to bear}こぐまのところへ、ぴょんぴょん。[warmly]「これ、あげる。ここに{squirrel:live bury}だいじにうめておくね。はるにおきて、おなかがすいたときのために」 {bear:face happy}{bear:hearts}こぐまはにっこり。{bear:live nap hold}ふわあーっと大あくびをして、こっくり。{sfx:snore}{acorn:face surprised}[whispers]「そっか、それがひみつだったんだ！」 とどんぐり。{squirrel:face happy}{squirrel:hearts}「もう、ひみつじゃないよ」 とリスさん。「やくそくだよ」

de-DE.title: Das Geheimnis des Eichhörnchens
de-DE.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Es war Herbst, und die Blätter wirbelten herab. {squirrel:enter} Das Eichhörnchen hatte ein Geheimnis: seine allerbeste Haselnuss. Da kam {acorn:enter} {acorn:go to squirrel} die Eichel, neugierig wie immer. {squirrel:face surprised} {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} Schnell versteckte das Eichhörnchen die Nuss hinter dem Rücken und guckte ganz unschuldig in die Luft. [curious] {acorn:pulse} „Was hast du da hinter dem Rücken?“, fragte die Eichel. [mischievously] „Gar nichts!“, sagte das Eichhörnchen. {acorn:live wish} Da wünschte sich die Eichel etwas: „Ich wünschte, ich wüsste es!“ So ging das den ganzen Tag. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop} „Was hast du da hinter dem Rücken?“ „Gar nichts!“ [giggles] {canvas:sunset 0.7} Als die Sonne unterging, kam {bear:enter} das Bärchen vorbeigetapst. [yawns] {bear:live talk} „Bald kommt der Winter“, sagte es. „Zeit für meinen langen Winterschlaf.“ {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Hervor kam die Haselnuss, und das Eichhörnchen drückte sie fest an sich. Dann {squirrel:go to bear} hüpfte es hinüber zum Bärchen. [warmly] „Die ist für dich. Ich {squirrel:live bury} vergrabe sie genau hier, ganz sicher, für den Frühling, wenn du hungrig aufwachst.“ {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} Das Bärchen lächelte, {bear:live nap hold} gähnte ganz groß und nickte ein. {sfx:snore} {acorn:face surprised} [whispers] „DAS war also das Geheimnis!“, sagte die Eichel. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hearts} „Jetzt ist es kein Geheimnis mehr“, sagte das Eichhörnchen. „Jetzt ist es ein Versprechen.“

fr-FR.title: Le cadeau d’Écureuil
fr-FR.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} C’était l’automne, et les feuilles tombaient en tourbillonnant. {squirrel:enter} Écureuil avait un secret : sa plus belle noisette. Et voilà qu’arrive {acorn:enter} {acorn:go to squirrel} Gland, toujours aussi curieux. {squirrel:face surprised} {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} Écureuil a caché la noisette derrière son dos, l’air de rien. [curious] {acorn:pulse} « Qu’est-ce que tu caches derrière ton dos ? » a demandé Gland. [mischievously] « Rien du tout ! » a dit Écureuil. {acorn:live wish} Alors Gland a fait un vœu : « Je voudrais tant savoir ! » Et ça a duré toute la journée. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop} « Qu’est-ce que tu caches ? » « Rien du tout ! » [giggles] {canvas:sunset 0.7} Puis, au coucher du soleil, {bear:enter} Ourson est passé à petits pas. [yawns] {bear:live talk} « L’hiver arrive, a-t-il dit. C’est l’heure de mon grand dodo. » {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Écureuil a sorti la noisette et l’a serrée contre lui. Puis il {squirrel:go to bear} a bondi jusqu’à Ourson. [warmly] « C’est pour toi. Je vais {squirrel:live bury} l’enterrer ici, bien à l’abri, pour quand tu te réveilleras le ventre vide au printemps. » {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} Ourson a souri, {bear:live nap hold} a bâillé un grand coup et s’est endormi. {sfx:snore} {acorn:face surprised} [whispers] « Alors c’était ÇA, le secret ! » a dit Gland. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hearts} « Ce n’est plus un secret, a dit Écureuil. C’est une promesse. »

it-IT.title: Il regalo segreto di Scoiattolo
it-IT.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6} {sfx:leaves} Era autunno, e le foglie cadevano piroettando. {squirrel:enter} Scoiattolo aveva un segreto: la sua nocciola più bella. Ecco arrivare {acorn:enter} {acorn:go to squirrel} Ghianda, curiosa come sempre. {squirrel:face surprised} {squirrel:live hide-nut hold} Scoiattolo ha nascosto la nocciola dietro la schiena, con l'aria da santarellino. [curious] {acorn:pulse} «Che cosa hai dietro la schiena?» ha chiesto Ghianda. [mischievously] «Niente!» ha detto Scoiattolo. {acorn:live wish} Allora Ghianda ha espresso un desiderio: «Vorrei tanto saperlo!» E così è andata avanti tutto il giorno. {acorn:face happy} {acorn:hop} «Che cosa hai dietro la schiena?» «Niente!» [giggles] {canvas:sunset 0.7} Poi, al tramonto, è passato di lì {bear:enter} Orsetto, trotterellando. [yawns] {bear:live talk} «Arriva l'inverno», ha detto. «È ora del mio lungo sonno.» {squirrel:live hide-nut resume} Fuori la nocciola, con un abbraccio. Poi Scoiattolo {squirrel:go to bear} è corso a balzi da Orsetto. [warmly] «È per te. La {squirrel:live bury} sotterro proprio qui, al sicuro, per quando ti sveglierai in primavera con un gran languorino.» {bear:face happy} {bear:hearts} Orsetto ha sorriso, {bear:live nap hold} ha fatto uno sbadiglio enorme e si è addormentato. {sfx:snore} {acorn:face surprised} [whispers] «Allora era QUESTO il segreto!» ha detto Ghianda. {squirrel:face happy} {squirrel:hearts} «Adesso non è più un segreto», ha detto Scoiattolo. «È una promessa.»

zh-TW.title: 松鼠藏禮物
zh-TW.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}{sfx:leaves}秋天到了，葉子轉呀轉地飄下來。{squirrel:enter}松鼠有一個祕密：牠最好最好的一顆榛果。{acorn:enter}{acorn:go to squirrel}橡實來了，她總是好奇得不得了。{squirrel:face surprised}{squirrel:live hide-nut hold}松鼠趕快把榛果藏到背後，一副什麼都沒有的樣子。[curious]{acorn:pulse}「你背後藏了什麼？」 橡實問。[mischievously]「沒有呀！」 松鼠說。{acorn:live wish}於是橡實許了一個願：「我好想知道喔！」 一整天都是這樣。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop}「你背後藏了什麼？」 「沒有呀！」 [giggles]{canvas:sunset 0.7}太陽下山的時候，{bear:enter}小熊搖搖晃晃地走過來。[yawns]{bear:live talk}「冬天快到了，」 牠說，「我要去睡好長好長的覺了。」 {squirrel:live hide-nut resume}松鼠拿出榛果，緊緊抱了一下。接著，松鼠{squirrel:go to bear}蹦蹦跳跳地跑到小熊身邊。[warmly]「這個送給你。我把它{squirrel:live bury}埋在這裡，藏得好好的，等春天你醒來肚子餓了，就有東西吃。」 {bear:face happy}{bear:hearts}小熊笑了，{bear:live nap hold}打了一個好大好大的呵欠，就睡著了。{sfx:snore}{acorn:face surprised}[whispers]「原來，這就是祕密呀！」 橡實說。{squirrel:face happy}{squirrel:hearts}「現在不是祕密了，」 松鼠說，「是一個約定。」

zh-HK.title: 松鼠收埋禮物
zh-HK.text: {canvas:leaves 0.6}{sfx:leaves}秋天到了，樹葉一片片打着轉飄下來。{squirrel:enter}松鼠有一個秘密：牠最好最好的一顆榛子。{acorn:enter}{acorn:go to squirrel}橡實走過來了，她總是對甚麼都好奇。{squirrel:face surprised}{squirrel:live hide-nut hold}松鼠連忙把榛子藏到背後，扮作甚麼事也沒有。[curious]{acorn:pulse}「你背後收埋咗啲乜呀？」 橡實問。[mischievously]「冇呀！」 松鼠說。{acorn:live wish}於是橡實許了一個願：「我好想知呀！」 一整天都是這樣。{acorn:face happy}{acorn:hop}「你背後收埋咗啲乜呀？」 「冇呀！」 [giggles]{canvas:sunset 0.7}太陽下山的時候，{bear:enter}小熊搖搖擺擺地走過來。[yawns]{bear:live talk}「冬天就嚟喇，」 牠說，「我要去瞓一個好長好長嘅覺喇。」 {squirrel:live hide-nut resume}松鼠拿出榛子，緊緊地抱了一下。然後，牠{squirrel:go to bear}一蹦一跳地來到小熊身邊。[warmly]「呢粒係畀你嘅。我幫你{squirrel:live bury}埋喺度，收得好好，等你春天醒咗肚餓，就有嘢食喇。」 {bear:face happy}{bear:hearts}小熊笑了，{bear:live nap hold}打了一個大大的呵欠，就睡着了。{sfx:snore}{acorn:face surprised}[whispers]「原來呢個就係秘密！」 橡實說。{squirrel:face happy}{squirrel:hearts}「而家唔係秘密喇，」 松鼠說，「係一個約定。」
